title: A Veil for the Sigil
author: Rafael Iversen
blurb: Isandro Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
